conventions.convention: The Jones normalization has V_U=1, x=t^(1/2), t=A^(-4), and x^(-2)V_+−x²V_−=(x−x^(-1))V_0. Full AC is assumed for library Jones invariance.
Set p=x−x^(-1); the unique expansion uses nonnegative integer indices q, finite support, and f_q=(a_q,b_q)^T. Finite-type order is explicitly excluded from the definition's assertions.
Crossing number is the least crossing count of regular diagrams, under the declared countable-choice hypothesis; the crossing-free unknot has crossing number zero.
The trefoil is the braid-direction-oriented closure of three positive geometric two-strand half twists; positive crossings have determinant sign +1 and bracket operator AI+A^(-1)e_1.
Carmi–Cohen v1's coefficient bound and unknot-detection conclusion are reported claims whose geometric proof has not been independently validated; neither is used as an established premise.

load_bearing.statement: Let x be an invertible indeterminate and put p=x−x^(-1). Every Laurent polynomial P(x)∈Z[x,x^(-1)] has a unique expression P(x)=a(p)+b(p)x with a,b∈Z[p].

For the library-normalized Jones polynomial, set p=x−x^(-1) and write V_K(x)=Σ_{q≥0}(a_q(K)+b_q(K)x)p^q with integer coefficients of finite support. Define f_q(K)=(a_q(K),b_q(K))^T and c_q(K)=a_q(K)+b_q(K).
